extract: Margaret Vivian Goodlander is an American politician, lawyer, and former naval officer who has served as the U.S. representative from New Hampshire's 2nd congressional district since 2025. A member of the Democratic Party, she is married to former U.S. national security advisor Jake Sullivan.
